entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'm in your hands. I think I owe you an apology, Scully. You and Mulder.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Sir?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I've been lying here thinking. Your quest... It should have been mine.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: If I die now, I die in vain. I have nothing to show for myself. My life--
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Sir, you know that's not true.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It is. I can see now that... I always played it safe. I wouldn't take sides. Wouldn't let you and Mulder... Pull me in.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You've been our ally more times than I can say.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Not the kind of ally that I could have been. I remember now.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I can't see his face. He has a beard.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Try.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He was at the gym. At the hospital. He killed that man. He was at the FBI when Orgel approached me.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: He was following you?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The tape. He's on the surveillance tape.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You must be surprised to see me here. I'm sure I'm not the man you're looking for.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: Where is he? Where's Orgel?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Orgel is dead.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: I don't believe you. You lied to me this morning, you're lying to me now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Drop this, Fox.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: Where is Orgel? I need to know what he knows. A friend of mine is dying.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I tell you, they killed him. What Orgel knows died with him.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: Tell me what you know, senator! This is about s.r. 819, isn't it? What the hell did they put in Skinner?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm sure you already have some idea, Fox.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: It's the same technology that s.r. 819 will export.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Technology that the world believes is purely theoretical.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: Nanotechnology. Microscopic, atom-sized machines? Machines can be stopped.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Your friend is already dead.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: I don't believe that.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: If you pursue this, Fox, they will kill you.
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: Not before I expose you and your role in this.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: My role? I am a victim here. Don't you understand that? I'm fighting for my life!
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: I will stop this!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's too late, Fox. It's too late!
entries.speaker: Senator Matheson

entries.text: [ monitor beeping ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ continuous beep ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: All right. He's coding on us. Clear. Dr. Cabrera, clear. Dr. Cabrera!
entries.speaker: Orderly

entries.text: Let him go.
entries.speaker: Dr. Katrina Cabrera

entries.text: Call time of death-- 9:33.
entries.speaker: Orderly

entries.text: [ gasping, coughing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Sir, I've spoken with your doctors, and your prognosis is excellent. Whatever you are infected with appears to be dormant. And your recovery is being hailed as a miracle.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The man who poisoned you was at the FBI that day. Scully was able to pull these off the security videotapes. Hoping it might jog your memory. Maybe you can identify this man.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No, I'm sorry.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: S.r. 819 was withdrawn by committee late last night without explanation.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Good. So this man failed then?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: If that was his true motive. If he wanted to poison you to prevent you from investigating s.r. 819, why call you to tell you that? This man worked for the government that was to receive this technology. He drove one of their cars, and he killed one of his own to save you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: So you still think this is about you? About the X-Files?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Yes. Yes, I do, and I have an idea who may be behind all this. But I'd need your authority to continue the investigation.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I have neither the authority nor the will... To allow your continued inquiry into this matter. You'll perform your duties as directed by a.d. Kersh, and only a.d. Kersh.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Sir?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: This matter's closed, agents. Am I clear?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ alarm chirps ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I've been expecting you to show up.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You know I can push the button any time.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: What do you want from me? What's this about, Krycek?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: All in good time.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek
